name: deskpulse
description: macOS menu-bar system diagnostics: live metrics, rotation-safe log tailing, local service health checks, and diagnostic export — Electron shell supervising a standalone Node.js agent.
author: Manuel Madubugini <manuelmadubugini@gmail.com>

scripts.make: npm run build -w @deskpulse/system-agent && npm run make -w @deskpulse/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build -w @deskpulse/system-agent && npm run package -w @deskpulse/desktop
scripts.test:e2e: npm run package && npm run e2e -w @deskpulse/e2e
